exposure.needed: which kafka.strimzi.io Kafka custom resources in the environment describe ZooKeeper-based (non-KRaft) clusters, or which use the ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters, and with it the KRaft migration support.

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: The changelog states only that the support was removed; it does not say whether an upgrade with a ZooKeeper-based cluster is blocked, whether the cluster stops working, or whether a migration must run first, so no failure kind can be asserted.
